name: 03_multi_region_notification_platform
description: Synthetic, high-complexity case mixing several partial-information patterns at once: a confirmed-but-out-of-scope component (DeliveryTracker) that must be excluded from Affected Components, an unanswered clarification about an *included* component's routing detail (RegionRouter) that must be reflected as a gap in its description rather than exclude the whole component, and a new data contract whose existence/producer/consumer/action are confirmed but whose schema fields are not — so the ODCS section must stay honest about what wasn't agreed rather than inventing a field list.
